Four copied Curve metapools: bounded historical configuration
review
Research date: 29 September 2026. Read-only evidence on PulseChain chain 369, blocks 17,233,000–
27,659,393. Endpoint hash: 0xc5e582cd902f4bff3b1aa325b9b564fcd5d6dc0ffa77a03fcd105b65c6390275.
Configuration-event finding
No selected post-fork amplification, fee or pool-administrator events were returned for these four named
pools. The collection completed without RPC query errors, and its endpoint block hash matched on
recheck.
Pool Address
OUSD / 3CRV 0x87650d7bbfc3a9f10587d7778206671719d9910d
mUSD / 3CRV 0x8474ddbe98f5aa3179b3b3f5942d724afcdec9f6
eUSD / FRAXBP 0xaeda92e6a3b1028edc139a4ae56ec881f3064d4f
FRAX / 3CRV 0xd632f22692fac7611d2aa1c0d552930d43caed3b
The selected signatures were RampA(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256), StopRampA(uint256,uint256), 
CommitNewFee(uint256,uint256,uint256), NewFee(uint256,uint256), CommitNewAdmin(uint256,address) and 
NewAdmin(address). The result does not establish that no economic rebalancing occurred: swaps and
liquidity additions/removals can change balances without any of these configuration events. It also does
not exclude changes in upstream factory ownership, token implementations, base pools or unlogged
storage.
Implementation and coverage limits
At the endpoint, OUSD/3CRV and FRAX/3CRV contain minimal-proxy bytecode pointing to 
0x5f890841f657d90e081babdb532a05996af79fe6. The published implementation ABI contains all six searched
configuration-event signatures and the standard exchange/liquidity event families used in the wallet
check.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 67

eUSD/FRAXBP points to 0x33bb0e62d5e8c688e645dd46dfb48cd613250067; the explorer did not provide a verified
ABI for that implementation. The mUSD pool contains full runtime bytecode, but its ABI request likewise
returned no ABI. Accordingly, queries of those two addresses are signature-family searches, not a claim
that all their possible configuration-event interfaces were audited. An unavailable explorer ABI is not
evidence that a pool does not function.
Examined-wallet exchange and liquidity history
A separate indexed-actor query found 820 events in 820 successful transactions, involving five
examined wallets. Every matched event was checked for exact inclusion in its successful receipt. An
additional sample of 19 earliest/latest transactions per pool/actor was reconciled with originating
transactions and block headers. The selected event families were the standard TokenExchange, 
TokenExchangeUnderlying, AddLiquidity, RemoveLiquidity, RemoveLiquidityOne and RemoveLiquidityImbalance
signatures. Counts are:
Pool Matched events
OUSD / 3CRV 19
mUSD / 3CRV 17
eUSD / FRAXBP 2
FRAX / 3CRV 782
Across these pools, the actors are c000 (690 events), 48Fc (116), e121 (11), BAD9 (2), and 6e3B (1). Full
addresses are in the address register (Appendix 6). No selected indexed-actor matches were returned for
FdbEE or the rollup address. Of the 820 events, 601 are underlying exchanges, 209 direct pool-coin
exchanges, six one-coin liquidity removals and four liquidity additions.
This is direct evidence of participation in the named markets, even though the selected configuration-
event search returned zero. It is not a complete wallet activity inventory: a router or intermediary may
appear as the event's indexed buyer/provider instead of the examined address. Missing such activity is a
known limitation. Conversely, participation does not alone identify common ownership, coordinated
intent or native L2 funding.
e121: actual mUSD-to-DAI and FRAX-to-USDT transfers
At block 27,264,036, e121 exchanged 13,489.157023144354307302 mUSD for 
564.501482257993107424 DAI. The successful receipt includes both the mUSD transfer from e121 to
the mUSD pool and the exact DAI transfer from that pool to e121. This establishes an actual stablecoin-
to-pDAI purchase by the named wallet, rather than merely a quote or a theoretical pool connection. 
Transaction.
At block 27,068,777, the same wallet exchanged 150,000 FRAX for 154,598.175347 USDT. The
receipt's FRAX input and USDT output transfers match the exchange event. Transaction. Five FRAX-to-
USDT exchange events from that wallet over blocks 27,068,777–27,068,922 total 731,000 FRAX input
and 753,387.520878 USDT output. These are gross flows in copied-token units, not a dollar valuation
or a complete net inventory change. A sixth nearby FRAX-pool event runs in the other direction, USDC
into FRAX.
The economic source of the spent mUSD and FRAX has not been reconciled to an L2 deposit or
authorized bridge mint. These receipts prove the destination trading leg; they do not close the source-to-
destination causal chain.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 68

Reproduction
The maintained manifest is Research/experiments/parb_curve_history_20260929.json, run by Research/scripts/
collect_pulsechain_events.py. Results, endpoint bytecode and source/ABI responses are preserved under
ignored artifacts/parb-curve-history-20260929/. This is a bounded public-history study; no calls that change
chain state or hypothetical privileged simulations were performed.
The full wallet event/receipt collection is wallet_events.json; the separate saved log index is 
wallet_event_index.json, and sampled header checks are in representative_wallet_receipts.json. Both event
collections agree on the 820 matches. The additional index was saved while full receipt verification was
in progress; the original verification subsequently completed successfully.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 69
